desc: Derive characterization: f(L,R) = number of maximal consecutive-integer runs in distinct values of A[L..R]; answer = Σ_v cnt1(v) − Σ_{v≥2} cnt2(v−1,v).
Design O(N) cnt1 via gap lengths between consecutive occurrences per value.
Design O(N) total cnt2 via merged occurrence-list walk per adjacent pair (total events ≤ 2N).
Implement final Python solution: fast I/O with sys.stdin.buffer, position lists per value, total1 via gaps, total2 via merged two-pointer walk, print total1 − total2.

Verify correctness: mental check on sample 1 (expect 16), sample 2 (expect 23); edge cases N=1, all-equal values, permutation 1..N. Found off-by-one bug in event handling (min at R=pos must include the event at pos).
Fix the off-by-one bug in the total2 merged-walk loop (add m_old·(pos−prev−1), update, add m_new) and produce the final corrected code; re-verified on samples 1 and 2 and extra traces.
